title: Nobody can tell whether the live HQ runs the newest code
what: HQ is put live by hand from the laptop; the cloud checks only test it. HQ shows no version number anywhere, and its main pages sit behind the Google sign-in, so the live copy cannot be compared with the code. Only the two public pages (offline page and install file) could be compared, and they match. HQ code last changed on 16 Nov 2026; whether that change is live is unknown.
expected: HQ shows a version or build label (or answers one on a public address), so anyone can see in one look whether live HQ matches the code.
fix_line: Stamp a short build label into HQ when it is put live and show it in the page footer and a public check address.

title: Four HQ tools are listed as switched off, but the live database already has what they wait for
what: The feature list marks changing a free trial, setting a plan by hand, AI Assistant credits and Payments to MettleUp as behind a switch. Each switch only waits for a database change, and the live database holds all of them, so these four tools are live today. Four more database change files (online checkout, payments to check, the retired AI pack name, the read log) still say on their first line that they are not applied, though the live database has them.
expected: The feature list and each database change file say live once the change is on the live database.
evidence: data:live catalog read 2026-11-25 (public function and table lists only) holds hq_set_trial, hq_set_plan, _trial_cap, _ai_balance, gym_ai_credit_ledger, hq_ai_wallet, hq_mettleup_payments, _mettleup_extend, gym_payment_ledger, _billing_on, hq_billing_checks, _plan_word, db_direct_reads, hq_db_reads
how_often: every time someone reads the feature list
fix_line: Mark these four HQ tools live in the feature list and change the first line of the four database files to applied live.
